title: Green Goddess Camembert Salad
subtitle: with tart green apple, crunchy walnuts & creamy guacamole
description: Sweet dreams are made of greens! Crumbed camembert tossed with peas, salad leaves, chickpeas and coated in our famous Green Goddess dressing: yoghurt, guacamole, and raspberry vinegar. Walnuts and fresh apples finish off this fresh dish with a divine crunch!

instructions.title: HOT CHICK
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the drained chickpeas on a roasting tray. Coat in oil and seasoning. Spread out in a single layer and roast in the hot oven for 15-20 minutes until crispy, shifting at the halfway mark.

instructions.title: WAL STREET
instructions.text: Place the walnuts in a pan over a medium heat. Toast for 3-5 minutes until browned, shifting occasionally. Remove from the pan and roughly chop.

instructions.title: GET DRESSED!
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine the guacamole and the yoghurt. Gradually loosen with milk or water in 30ml increments until drizzling consistency. Pour in the raspberry vinegar (to taste), seasoning, and mix until combined.

instructions.title: GRIN AND CAMEMBERT IT
instructions.text: In a shallow dish, combine the breadcrumbs and the rub (seasoned lightly). Prepare another shallow dish with 1 egg whisked with 1 tbsp of water. Dip each camembert slice into the egg, and then lightly coat in the breadcrumbs. Return the pan to a medium-high heat with enough oil to coat the base. When hot, fry the crumbed camembert for 1 minute each side, until golden brown. Remove from the pan and drain on paper towel.

instructions.title: LET'S ASSEMBLE!
instructions.text: Boil the kettle. Submerge the peas in boiling water for 2-3 minutes until plump and heated through. Drain on completion and place in a salad bowl. Cut the rinsed apple into cubes and place in the salad bowl with the peas. Add the salad leaves, ½ the crispy chickpeas and ½ the green goddess dressing. Toss until fully coated.

instructions.title: FEAST LIKE A GODDESS
instructions.text: Bowl up a portion of crunchy salad. Top with the crispy camembert and drizzle over the remaining green goddess dressing. Garnish with the remaining chickpeas, chopped parsley, and chopped walnuts. Gorgeous!
